description: This file defines the DeleteMeetingCommandHandler class, which handles the deletion of meeting entities in the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes delete commands, and delegates the deletion to the MeetingWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DeleteMeetingCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles delete commands for meetings, implementing command processing logic and delegating to the MeetingWritePlatformService.

methods.name: DeleteMeetingCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the MeetingWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking deleteMeeting on the writePlatformService.
